description: This file defines the WaiveLoanChargeCommandHandler class, which handles the command to waive a loan charge within the loan account module of the application. It implements the processCommand method that invokes the service to perform the waiver operation.

classes.name: WaiveLoanChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the command to waive a loan charge, integrating with the loan charge write platform service and processing commands within a transactional context.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the waive loan charge command by delegating to the write platform service to execute the waiver logic.
